title: Speed, Jump and Movement
intro: How fast Speed makes you walk in MapleStory Classic, the 140 cap, every Speed and Jump source, jump height, rope climbing and Teleport range.

blocks.p: [[img:11f90822dc92bf.png]] At the base Speed of 100, your character walks 150 pixels per second in MapleStory Classic World. Every point of Speed adds 1.25 px/s, up to the cap of 140 (200 px/s). Jump caps at 120.
We measured COT2 video footage closely, frame by frame, and got these results.

blocks.h2: How fast does Speed make you walk?

blocks.p: Walking speed is 125 × (Speed + 20) / 100 pixels per second. The table lists every fifth point from the base to the cap.
Speed above 140 does nothing. Speed also has no effect on how fast you attack. Attack speed is a weapon stat (attack speed guide).

blocks.h2: Does Speed work like it did before Big Bang?

blocks.p: No. Pre-Big Bang MapleStory walked 125 px/s at Speed 100. MapleStory Classic World adds 20 Speed behind the scenes, so your 100 moves like the old 120.
The cap is still 140. That now walks 200 px/s, the same as the old Speed 160. Old speed advice is outdated for this reason. Jump works the old way, but its cap dropped from 123 to 120.

blocks.h2: Where do you get Speed and Jump?

table: GM event buff; lasts 60 min or until you log out
Beginner skill; lasts 10 to 30 sec; 3 min cooldown
Level 70 shoes carry +4; each pair has 5 upgrade slots

blocks.p: Haste stacks with a Speed Potion and with Nimble Feet. An Assassin's Haste and a Bandit's Haste don't stack with each other, and casting Haste again only refreshes its timer. GM's Blessing of Wind stacks with other boosts.
Shoe scrolls add Speed or Jump:

table: 10%; a failed scroll has a 50% chance to destroy the shoes

blocks.h2: Can you reach the Speed cap?

blocks.p: Yes. Thieves get there with max Haste, a Speed Potion and any shoes with +2 Speed. Anyone else needs a Red Whip or a GM's Blessing of Wind during an event, plus a Speed Potion and Speed shoes.

table: Level 70 shoes (+4), White Napoleon (+3), Speed Potion
Same, with five +2 Speed scrolls on the shoes
Red Whip, level 70 shoes, White Napoleon, Speed Potion
Same, with five +2 Speed scrolls on the shoes
GM's Blessing of Wind, Speed Potion, shoes with +2 Speed
Max Haste, Speed Potion, shoes with +2 Speed

blocks.p: Nimble Feet adds another 10 on top of Haste for up to 30 seconds, so a Thief with max Haste hits the cap during Nimble Feet with no gear at all.
At Jump 100 you rise 77 px. Each point of Jump adds launch speed, so height grows a little faster than Jump itself.
Max Haste adds 10 Jump, worth 16 px of height. Need to attack while you're in the air? See Attacks You Can Use Mid-Jump.

blocks.h2: How fast do you climb ropes?

blocks.p: Your climbing speed in px/s is your Speed plus 20. At the base you climb 120 px/s. Ladders use the same speed, and Haste speeds up climbing too.

blocks.h2: How long does it take to cross a map?

blocks.p: Time to walk the full width of each map. Ropes, slopes and jumps add more.
Max Haste saves about 9 seconds on a walk across Henesys.
Every Magician gets Teleport at second job. A max-level Teleport covers the distance you walk in one second at Speed 100.
